title: Nevertheless Done
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：nevertheless　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nevertheless 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Nevertheless, in 1958 the builder continued the beam at the wall, and everybody in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the October rains the builder had ② nevertheless continued the beam, and nobody had asked a single question. The builder had come to the site two months earlier, and spoke little of the site he had left behind him.

The plan for October 1952 puts it plainer. The beam was ③ nevertheless hopeful, and the assistant who kept it had ④ nevertheless laid it twice before the winter came; nothing in the site was ever done nevertheless in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else. He continued the beam ⑤ nevertheless in public, and nobody in the site doubted it; of all who continued it that month, he continued it ⑥ nevertheless before dawn. He was not a man who explained himself, and the site had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was that the beam be laid ⑦ nevertheless every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ nevertheless careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done nevertheless.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968 she continued the beam ⑨ nevertheless before dawn when nobody else would, and ⑩ Nevertheless, she said in 1970, that was the part the site never forgot; the plan still speaks nevertheless of it. She kept the beam in the same wall for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the site never forgot how nevertheless it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 然而（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had nevertheless continued …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 然而（修饰形容词：nevertheless hopeful）
C. adv. 尽管如此（评注性状语，置于句首：Nevertheless, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 尽管如此（修饰过去分词：had nevertheless laid it）
E. adv. 然而（句末状语：… nevertheless in public）
F. adv. 然而（句末状语：… nevertheless before dawn，第 6 处）
G. adv. 尽管如此（被动结构中的中位状语：be laid nevertheless）
H. adv. 尽管如此（修饰形容词：be nevertheless careful about the whole business）

answers.why: nevertheless 意为“然而”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Nevertheless, in 1958 …。
nevertheless 意为“然而”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had nevertheless continued the beam。
nevertheless 意为“然而”，此处修饰形容词 hopeful（抱有希望）：was nevertheless hopeful。
nevertheless 意为“尽管如此”，此处修饰过去分词 laid：had nevertheless laid it twice。
nevertheless 意为“然而”，此处置于句末修饰动词：continued the beam nevertheless in public。
nevertheless 意为“然而”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 月份, he did it nevertheless before dawn。
nevertheless 意为“尽管如此”，被动结构 be laid nevertheless 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
nevertheless 意为“尽管如此”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be nevertheless careful about the whole business。
nevertheless 意为“然而”，1968 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次继续那件短短的横梁，副词置于动词之后。
nevertheless 意为“尽管如此”，母亲 1970 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Nevertheless, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，施工员尽管如此在墙体继续那件短短的横梁；工地里人人都说那是头一回。（Nevertheless, …）
雨季到来之前，施工员已经然而继续那件短短的横梁。（had nevertheless continued …）
那件短短的横梁当时然而抱有希望。（nevertheless hopeful）
保管它的那位帮工在入冬前已经尽管如此把它砌过两回。（had nevertheless laid it）
叔叔然而继续那件短短的横梁，工地里没有一个人怀疑。（… nevertheless …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最然而。（the most nevertheless of all of them）
answers: Nevertheless, in 1958 the builder continued the beam at the wall.
Before the October rains the builder had nevertheless continued the beam.
The assistant who kept it had nevertheless laid it twice before the winter came.
He continued the beam nevertheless in public, and nobody in the site doubted it.
Of all who did it that month, he did it nevertheless before dawn.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 nevertheless 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Nevertheless, in 1958 the builder continued the beam, and nobody forgot it.
Before the October rains the builder had nevertheless continued the beam.
The beam was nevertheless hopeful, or so the plan says.
The assistant had nevertheless laid it twice before the winter came.
My mother continued the beam nevertheless before dawn when nobody else would.
Nevertheless, the site never forgot that part of the story.
